title.narrative: Status of effective gender sensitive multistakeholder dialogues addressing legal forest production and trade

description.narrative: This indicator is designed to assess the status of effective gender sensitive multistakeholder dialogues addressing legal forest production and trade in the four VPA countries. Effective participation refers to when male and female stakeholders have a say in the formulation of the forest policy, law and regulation reform processes / VPArelated reform processes and can influence their outcomes. Effectiveness is qualitatively assessed by FLEGT Asias VPA country focal points. Gender sensitivity is captured in the percentage of men and women representation in national platforms such as the Technical Working Group, Negotiation Support and Development Committee, Adhoc Working Group, Joint Implementation Committee, Multistakeholder Core Group.

comment.narrative: By 2023 Structures and mechanisms for dialogue between government and other stakeholders on VPA process remain functioning in four 4 countries.

title.narrative: Value of trade in legal and sustainable timber and timber products from the region

description.narrative: This indicator is designed to track the value of trade in timber and timber products as documented by VPA countries in the region.

comment.narrative: Data comes from ITTO IMM and other international statistics such as the UN COMTRADE and EUROSTAT.
By June 2024 the value of legal trade in the region as documented by recognised legality assurance systems has increased by 25.

In 2024 the value of legal trade in the region totalled at approximately EUR 5.8 billion out of which about EUR 434.5 million was FLEGTlicensed timber products from Indonesia to the EU. Between 2021 and 2023 the value of legal trade in the region totalled at approximately EUR 40.7 billion out of which about EUR 2.76 billion was FLEGTlicensed timber products from Indonesia to the EU
